technical-summary: RSP01 phase 2 redesigned as one Python-free engine release: a single asset of binaries and data, no Python and no shell launcher, start-up through bc-serve, archs.toml compiled in, RSC12 configs shipped, trust as a tag-bound digest, current and previous release kept for rollback, and a gate table mapping each remaining Python or shell behaviour to the RSC02 step that rewrites it. PR 1022.
user-summary-candidate: The engine release will ship without Python.
